name: RamDev Dale Borglum
reason: His own site, the Living/Dying Project (www.livingdying.org; robots.txt allows all), answered our first page request with a Cloudflare 'Just a moment' challenge (403, 5 Nov 2026). Under the blocked-means-skip rule it was not retried and nothing more was fetched from it; no other site of his own turned up in two searches (only hub pages such as Hollyhock and Menla, and podcast pages), so there is no usable published email or contact form, base or photo source. Note for the owner: his work is centred on spiritual care for the dying (Living/Dying Project, conscious dying), framed partly around life-threatening illness, which would also need a careful health-rule pass.
